cases.name: document-vector
cases.query: DOCUMENTS {operation:'search_vector',query:{max_documents:3,hits_per_document:1},vector:[1,0],options:{strategy:'exact'}} RETURN _.id AS id,document.document_id AS doc,document.score AS score,similarity(_) AS cosine

cases.name: document-text
cases.query: DOCUMENTS {operation:'search',query:{text:'alpha',max_documents:3,hits_per_document:1}} RETURN _.id AS id,document.source_id AS source,text_score(_) AS score ORDER BY id

cases.name: graph-union
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words','events']} MATCH (a)-[e:rel]->(b) RETURN a.id AS a,b.id AS b,e.graph_id AS graph,e.weight AS weight ORDER BY graph,a,b

cases.name: graph-reverse
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words']} MATCH (a)<-[e:rel]-(b) RETURN a.id AS a,b.id AS b,e.graph_id AS graph

cases.name: graph-optional
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words']} OPTIONAL MATCH (a {id:31})-[e:rel]->(b) RETURN a.id AS a,b.id AS b,e.graph_id AS graph

cases.name: graph-default
cases.query: MATCH (a)-[e:rel]->(b) RETURN a.id AS a,b.id AS b,e.graph_id AS graph,e.weight AS weight

cases.name: graph-path
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['events']} MATCH (a {id:11})-[:rel*1..2]->(b) RETURN b.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.name: graph-bindings
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words','events']} MATCH (a)-[e:rel]->(b) WITH a AS source,b AS target,e AS relation RETURN source.id AS a,target.id AS b,relation.graph_id AS graph,relation.weight AS weight ORDER BY graph,a,b

cases.name: document-expand
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words']} DOCUMENTS {operation:'search_vector',query:{max_documents:1},vector:[1,0],options:{strategy:'exact'}} WITH _ AS seed,document AS evidence EXPAND seed [:rel*1..1] AS related RETURN related.id AS id,evidence.document_id AS doc

cases.name: graph-degree
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words']} MATCH (n) WITH n AS seed degree seed AS ranked RETURN ranked.id AS id,graph_score(ranked) AS score ORDER BY id

cases.name: graph-weighted-path
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['events']} MATCH (n {id:11}) WITH n AS seed weighted_paths seed to [31] label rel AS reached RETURN reached.id AS id,weighted_distance(reached) AS cost,path(reached) AS path

cases.name: document-binary-full
cases.query: DOCUMENTS {operation:'search_vector',query:{max_documents:3,hits_per_document:1},vector:[18446744073709551615,1],options:{strategy:'exact'}} RETURN _.id AS id,document.score AS score

cases.name: document-expand-similarity
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['events']} DOCUMENTS {operation:'search_vector',query:{max_documents:1},vector:[1,0],options:{strategy:'exact'}} WITH _ AS seed,document AS evidence EXPAND seed [:rel*1..2] AS related WITH related,evidence WHERE similarity(related) >= 0 RETURN related.id AS id,evidence.document_id AS doc,similarity(related) AS score

cases.name: document-hybrid
cases.query: DOCUMENTS {operation:'search_hybrid',query:{text:'alpha',max_documents:3,hits_per_document:1},vector:[1,0],options:{vector:{strategy:'exact'},text_weight:1}} WITH _,document,document.scores AS components RETURN _.id AS id,document.score AS score,similarity(_) AS cosine,text_score(_) AS bm25,components.vector_rank AS vr,components.text_rank AS tr

cases.name: graph-with-default
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words'],include_default:true} MATCH (a)-[e:rel]->(b) RETURN a.id AS a,b.id AS b,e.graph_id AS graph,e.weight AS weight ORDER BY b

cases.name: graph-stage-membership
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words']} FIND {data:{$exists:true}} WITH _ AS seed degree seed AS ranked RETURN ranked.id AS id,graph_score(ranked) AS score ORDER BY id

cases.name: graph-nonmember
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words']} MATCH (n {id:10}) RETURN n.id AS id

cases.name: graph-distinct-identity
cases.query: GRAPH {graph_ids:['words','events']} MATCH (a)-[e:rel]->(b) RETURN DISTINCT COUNT(e) AS total
